concerns.text: The plan applies Benjamini‑Hochberg FDR correction to p‑values obtained from an *unregularized post‑selection* logistic regression that uses the same data on which the L1‑regularized model performed variable selection. This creates a circular inference loop: predictors are first selected based on the data, then the same data are used to test their significance, violating the independence assumption required for valid hypothesis testing. Without a proper selective‑inference or data‑splitting strategy, the reported significant predictors may be artefacts of over‑fitting, rendering the significance claims unreliable.
